TX-27.name: Tanya Lloyd
TX-27.evidence: Rural teacher running on 'American Rural Revival'; backs moving toward Medicare for All/public option, 'rigged game' tax rhetoric, but also all-of-the-above energy and 'secure and humane' border. No left-org endorsements found.

MO-5.name: Emanuel Cleaver
MO-5.evidence: Long-time incumbent (since 2005), former KC mayor and CBC chair; conventional party-line Democrat, civility-caucus chair. Fetched page is current Wikipedia (undated).

SEN-KY.name: Charles Booker
SEN-KY.evidence: 2026 launch platform: Medicare, housing, wages, universal childcare, government that 'shows up for us'; previously the Sanders/AOC-backed Medicare-for-All insurgent; frames race as anger at McConnell/Barr establishment. No confirmed 2026 Sanders/OR endorsement (Warren endorsed).

TN-3.name: Anna Golladay
TN-3.evidence: Described as a 'progressive faith leader' (ex-UMC pastor); universal coverage, 'care over cruelty', attacks incumbent serving 'donors and party bosses' and 'corporate greed'. No left-org endorsements found.

TX-6.name: Danny Minton
TX-6.evidence: Ex-Republican self-described 'working-class candidate'; tax billionaires/corporations, small business vs monopolies, Green New Deal, shrink/abolish ICE, Democrats shouldn't take orders from consultants or big-money donors. No left-org endorsements found.

NJ-5.name: Josh Gottheimer
NJ-5.evidence: Problem Solvers Caucus and Blue Dog member; self-described 'passionately centrist', critic of democratic socialism; incumbent seeking re-election after 2025 governor primary loss. Fetched page is current Wikipedia (undated).

IL-5.name: Mike Quigley
IL-5.evidence: Incumbent since 2009, New Democrat Coalition member in a safe Chicago seat; party-line record; running for Chicago mayor 2027. Fetched page is current Wikipedia (undated).

NY-12.name: Micah Lasher
NY-12.evidence: Assemblymember and former Nadler/Hochul aide; endorsed by Nadler as successor (and per search results Hochul, Bloomberg, Levine, Hoylman-Sigal). Conventional institutional profile.

AR-1.name: Terri Yarbrough Green
AR-1.evidence: Retired pathologist, long-time party activist; affordability, democracy 'under severe threat', Congress as check on executive, government for working families 'not just wealthy insiders', civility. No ideological markers or endorsements.

TX-9.name: Leticia Gutierrez
TX-9.evidence: Environmental-justice advocate (Air Alliance Houston), daughter of farm laborers, single mother courting working-class families; universal health care; 'open for business'; endorsed by SEIU Texas and Gulf Coast labor federation (Houston Progressives per voter guide).

TX-14.name: Thurman Bartie
TX-14.evidence: Retired former Port Arthur mayor, educator/pastor; Lone Star Left called both runoff candidates 'very nice liberal grandpas', contrasting them with a young progressive. No positions/endorsements found.

IL-2.name: Donna Miller
IL-2.evidence: Cook County Commissioner; family-focused message; backed by Tribune/Sun-Times, SEIU, AFL-CIO, EMILY's List, DMFI, Lightfoot plus heavy outside super PAC spending (endorsement list from search results, not fetched). Fetched article gives no ideology.

NC-13.name: Paul Barringer
NC-13.evidence: Farm-family healthcare consultant/lawyer running on 'common sense and North Carolina values', fiscal responsibility, local control, 'bringing people together, not dividing them' in a swing seat national Dems targeted.
